standard_prerequisites.name: Separated spaces are closed in finite presentation ones

standard_prerequisites.use: Diagram with X'' -> P^n_Y an immersion and pi : X'' -> X' proper surjective.

standard_prerequisites.name: Properness and closed immersion permanence

standard_prerequisites.use: pi^{-1}(X) -> P^n_Y is a closed immersion.

standard_prerequisites.name: Eventually closed immersion
standard_prerequisites.use: X_i' -> P^n_Y closed immersion for i large.

standard_prerequisites.name: Image of a proper morphism is proper
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Morphisms of Spaces, Lemma spaces-morphisms-lemma-image-proper-is-proper (cross-chapter, cited at ~3180-3181)

core_obligations: 表出：proposition-separated-closed-in-finite-presentation 给闭浸入 X→X'（X' 分离 fp over Y）；lemma-closed-is-limit-closed-and-finite-presentation 写 X=lim X_i（X_i→X' 闭浸入 fp）；断言大 i 使 X_i→Y proper（~3145-3152 行）。
化归与弱 Chow：proper-local 设 Y 仿射；weak Chow 给图 X''→P^n_Y 浸入、π:X''→X' proper 满；X_i'=X'' 中 X_i 的 scheme-theoretic 原像、π^{-1}(X) 为 X 的 scheme-theoretic 原像；lim X_i'=π^{-1}(X)（~3154-3170 行）。

收尾：π^{-1}(X)→Y proper（composition）⇒ π^{-1}(X)→P^n_Y 闭浸入（universally-closed-permanence + immersion-when-closed）；lemma-eventually-closed-immersion 给大 i 使 X_i'→P^n_Y 闭浸入 ⇒ X_i' proper over Y；image-proper-is-proper 得 X_i→Y proper（~3170-3181 行）。
proof_roadmap: 闭浸入表出 + 两级极限（~3145-3152 行）。
弱 Chow + scheme-theoretic 原像（~3154-3170 行）。
最终闭浸入 + proper 收尾（~3170-3181 行）。
difficulty_reason: 两级表出 + 弱 Chow + scheme-theoretic 原像 + 最终闭浸入全程展示、每步具名锚定；无省略。
